answer: An AI-agent network handling kernel builds, yarrow monitoring, and prism telemetry can deter Sybil attacks through stake-bonded escrow. To gain routing rights, each agent locks scarce tokens in a contract that slashes deposits upon equivocation or invalid proofs. Spawning fake identities thus imposes verifiable illiquid capital costs per account. However, stake bonding bars low-capital newcomers and cannot stop wealthy adversaries from buying disproportionate influence.
